title: Hazel and the Echo
author: Isandro Ashgrove
blurb: Sable Eriksen, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the fleet's truce expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
